sentence: 七福パークだな？　時間が出来た時に行くぜ。
literal: Shichifuku Park, right? I'll head over when I get the time.
official_candidate: The president? I figure he'd be at the office at this hour.
official_neighbors: You have your tank back there fight us for it. He beats all three of us, the two million's yours! We win, and we don't owe you a thing.
Shit, you're not drunk, you're crazy! Bruno's famous around here for busting heads. All three of you could rush him at the same time and he'd snap you like twigs.
Nah, nah! Fight's gotta be one-on-one. Rules and all. Three against one wouldn't be fair.
Ha! You want to take him on SOLO!? Well, hell. If you don't mind me taking the money off your corpse, I'm game. You got yourself a deal!
Well that's just lovely.
I'll tell you right now I'm not bailing you out. If you don't want to get hurt, I'd start apologizing now.
Okay, I'll go first then!
Hey, are you even listening!? Are you sure you want to do this?
He'll be fine. Just a little workout. You just focus on keeping an eye on the action, boy. Watch Kamoji's moves.
Seriously!?
Aaand, FIGHT!
Huff, whew... I'm tired. Gotta remember to eat before I do this stuff.
Kamoji, was it? What were those moves just now? Actually, forget it. Are you okay? You shouldn't push yourself like that.
Ha ha, he's fine! Told you, didn't I? Big guy didn't land a single punch on him.
Hey, you in the coat. Homeless dude! Bruno's barely got a scratch on him. You gonna try to finish the job with those weak-ass punches?
Ah, no. Kamoji-kun, you sit this one out. I'm calling the round as your manager! Let the kid take it from here.
You know what to do, don't you, boy?
Heh... Yeah, all right. I meant it when I said I wouldn't bail you out, but watching him just put me in the mood for a quick round.
Right, then. On to round two of the two-million yen murder parade! Bruno? Take him!
What just happened? Bruno barely got a punch in! Just who the hell ARE you?
Name's Kiryu. Dojima Family. Which family are you guys with?
Whoa, wait, you're a proper yakuza!? Er, s-sorry, sir! I didn't know! We just work for Toko Credit.
Well there's a coincidence. I have business with your boss. Need to meet with him as soon as possible. You know where he is right now?
The president? I figure he'd be at the office at this hour.
I see. That's in a building on Taihei Boulevard East, right? I'll pay him a visit then.
And that takes care of that little debt of ours, right?
Yeah, fine. A deal's a deal. Bruno here will have to cover the difference. That's how our kinda debt collection works.
Ha ha! Whew, it's a tough world, I tell ya.
Well, I better get moving. C'mon, Bruno. Pick it up!
Hey, tell me something.
Just who are you? Why approach me? What are you after?
Me? Yes, well, people here call me Bacchus. And I came to you because I had an angry thug on my butt!
Yeah, nice of you to dump him on me... Look, if you're in some trouble, tell me. Maybe I can help.
And that goes for him, too. Those weren't the moves of an amateur. What's his deal?
A real steal of a deal, is what it is! He's got a gig sweeter than honey. Real fascinating to watch. You should go have a look too, boy!
At Kamoji's job? But he's homeless, right? What kind of work does he do?
He's a... whatchacallit. A fisting artist!
Whoa... That's not really my scene.
That ain't it! It's PUNCHOUT artist.
Yeah, that! A punchout artist. Heh, slip of the tongue.
...All right, so what's a punchout artist?
The customer pays a fee, then they get to throw as many punches at me as they like.
I don't think I follow. This some new S&M thing?
Naw, nothing like that! Come on by and watch, if you got questions. I work in the Shichifuku Parking Lot.
Kamoji-kun here's got plenty to teach you about fighting, my boy. You'll kick yourself if you don't check it out.
All right, I get the picture. Shichifuku Parking Lot, right? I'll swing by if I can find the time.
It's Kiryu-san, from the Dojima Family, right? I'll be waiting! See you soon.
Well, that takes care of my troubles for today... I suppose I still can't convince you to take on the world?
